name: texture
title: game.texture
lead: Returns a new texture of width by height pixels, see-through until drawn on, for a pack's block or item.

usedIn.quote: pack, or a `game.texture`; `detail = 2` has four times the pixels. Or
local ingot = game.texture(16, 16)       -- a picture drawn in code, or a PNG file in the pack
local t = game.texture(16, 16)            -- see-through until drawn on
